nga-1132.text: This image depicts a man from the waist up. He is seated, slightly turned to his right, while facing the viewer. The man has a composed expression, prominent cheekbones, and a slightly pointed nose. His dark brown hair is styled in a classic early 19th-century manner, with curls around the sides and forehead. He is dressed in a dark blue coat with gold buttons, a yellow waistcoat, a high-collared white shirt, and a decorative pin. In his right hand, he holds a piece of folded paper with writing on it. The background is an indistinct swirl of darker colors.

nga-43.text: This painting depicts a woman seated outdoors with a baby in her lap on the left and a young child standing nearby on the right. The woman is sitting on the ground, while the baby is facing the right with their arms outstretched. The baby is partially wrapped in a white cloth. The woman has a serene expression and delicate facial features. She is wearing a green and red robe. The young child on the right is holding a small lamb and has curly blond hair. In the upper left corner of the painting, two cherubic faces peer down from a cloud.

nga-34150.text: The image is a portrait of a man in a three-quarter view. He has neutral facial expression with almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. His light-colored hair is styled back with curls framing his face. He wears a dark coat with a wide, red collar over a white shirt. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a muted brown color with no distinct details.

nga-53584.text: The image shows a woman seated in an ornate armchair. She has fair skin, blue eyes, dark hair styled in an updo, and is wearing a dark dress with puffed sleeves and a lace collar. She holds a red book and there is a double-strand pearl necklace around her neck. In the background, there is a column and a landscape with mountains under a cloudy sky.

nga-71023.text: Livestock, woodland animals, and about a dozen people cluster in groups throughout a densely wooded landscape with rocky outcroppings and the ruins of a round structure in this horizontal painting. The people all appear to have light skin. A narrow river curves from near the lower left corner of the composition back around a grove of trees on a spit of land. One white, long-necked bird stands near a rock on the riverbank, and a second bird, shown in flight low over the water, clutches a short snake in its beak.

nga-42451.text: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. The man has a serious expression and wide eyes, with short dark hair styled in an upward manner. He is dressed in a dark coat and a high collared white shirt with a decorative front. The background is a solid dark teal color.

nga-34054.text: The image shows a person from the waist up, in a seated position with the body slightly angled to the right while the head is turned towards the left. The person has light skin, brown hair that is parted in the middle, and falls to just below the ears, with a distinctive full mustache and beard along the jawline. The person is dressed in a dark jacket over a vibrant red vest and a high-collared blue shirt or tie is visible. A small pin adorns the blue fabric. The background is a textured mix of warm brown tones.

nga-50692.text: This is a painting of three men standing closely together on a brown dirt path between two bodies of water. The men are walking towards us, looking at one another. The central figure has long hair, a mustache, and a beard, and is wearing a pink robe. To his left, a man with short brown hair wears a brown robe with a blue cloak, a cane at his side. To the right, a man with curly brown hair and a beard wears a brown cap and a light brown robe with a blue cloak. All three men have light skin and are barefoot.

nga-176888.text: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man depicted in a three-quarter view. He is seated upright, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a solemn expression with a prominent chin, thin lips, and alert eyes. His hair is short and appears grey, combed to lay flat against his head. He is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a dark colored coat with large lapels, a white shirt, and an intricately tied white cravat. The background of the image is a simple, solid color, which is a soft peachy tone, providing no additional context or detail.

nga-59903.text: The image shows a young girl from the waist up, slightly turned to her left, with a calm expression. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark eyes, and dark brown curly hair. She is wearing a pink gown with lace-trimmed sleeves, a ruffled neckline, and a string of pearls around her neck. She is holding a small bird in her right hand. The background is dark and oval-shaped, and the portrait is enclosed in a dark circular border.

nga-129283.text: This painting shows a group of people in a forest. They are closely gathered, some seated on the ground, others standing, and a few mounted on horses. The person in the center of the group is seated on the left, dressed in colorful attire and raising one hand up while holding a small cross wrapped in fabric in the other hand. Surrounding them are men, women, and children of varying ages wearing cloaks or simple garments, some with hats or headscarves. Their expressions vary, some turning to speak to one another. Many people hold tall staffs.

nga-59936.text: The image shows a full-body portrait of a young child standing indoors. The child faces forward with a neutral expression, looking directly at the viewer. They have neatly styled brown hair parted in the middle. The child wears a white dress with lace detailing at the collar and puffed short sleeves, over layered pantaloons. The dress has intricate patterns along the hem. They hold a bunch of flowers in their left hand and a red ribbon in their right hand, which trails down to the floor. A small cat playfully touches the end of the ribbon near the child's feet.

nga-43444.text: This painting shows a woman standing upright, holding a cup with a bald eagle drinking from it. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, red lips, long curly brown hair, and is wearing a classical style gown. The gown has a blue bodice that cuts diagonally across her torso, under which is a flowing white skirt gathered at the side to reveal her leg and the lace-up sandals she wears. She holds a thin pole with an American flag hanging from it. In her other hand, she holds a white cup or bowl. A large bald eagle flies over her and dips its head down to drink from the cup.

cma-283088.text: This icon depicts an important subject in Orthodox Christian art, the three corresponding figures of the single godhead known as the Holy Trinity. The Trinity is represented here in a composition known as the “New Testament Trinity,” which features Christ and God the Father seated on a bench with a dove representing the Holy Spirit between them. The central field is occupied by a large wooden throne with gold highlights on which Christ (left) and the Ancient of the Days (God the Father as Christ in old age) are seated.

nga-32691.text: Shown from the knees up, a woman sitting next to an eagle has pale skin and rosy cheeks, and she faces and looks at us in this vertical portrait painting. The woman takes up most of the height of the composition and her right arm, on our left, rests on what looks like a puffy, sand-colored cloud. Her long, light blond hair is pulled back but one long tendril rests over her right shoulder, on our left. White and pale pink roses are tucked into a string of white pearls pinned into her hair across top of her head.

nga-42453.text: In the image, a man is seated in a wooden chair, facing forward. He has light skin, blue eyes, dark brown curly hair, and wears a high-collared coat over a striped cravat. There is a white cloth around his neck, and he holds a thin object in one hand while a hat rests on his lap. A wooden bookshelf with several books is in the background.

cma-122339.text: This work reinterprets the most common subject in Renaissance art—the Madonna and Child. The tender relationship of mother and son spoke to Mary’s role as intercessor for humanity, sparked an empathetic relationship with Christ, and helped invest Christian practice with tenderness and compassion. Works at this scale were usually for private devotion, but distinct styles and refined craftsmanship were also appreciated for their artistry and creativity. Here the donors occupy the same landscape as the holy figures, emphasizing how Mary’s compassion extends into our world.

nga-52274.text: The image is a portrait painting of a woman. She is seated with her body turned slightly to the right, while her head is facing forward towards the viewer. She has a gentle expression with slightly raised eyebrows. Her light brown hair is styled in loose curls framing her face. The woman is wearing a light-colored dress with a high collar and long sleeves, and a dark shawl over her shoulders. Her hands are resting on her lap, one lightly holding the fabric of her dress. She is wearing earrings. The background is a deep, muted blend of dark hues with hints of leaves or branches.

nga-50301.text: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is facing forward with her hands resting on a book held upright. She has a composed expression with light skin, defined lips, and prominent cheekbones. Her hair is styled in a neat updo, and she wears a lace-trimmed bonnet. She is dressed in a dark, full-sleeved dress with a lace collar and a pin at the center. The background is a muted brown.

nga-32684.text: Towering, pale, celery-green trees frame a view of a lush park with about a dozen elegantly dressed, light-skinned men and women in this vertical landscape painting. The color palette is dominated by moss and lemon-lime green, golden yellow, and spruce blue. The men all wear jackets with long tails over knee-breeches, and their long hair is pulled back at the napes of their necks. The women wear long dresses with full skirts and hints of lace at the sleeves and bust, and their brown or white hair is pulled up.

nga-437.text: This painting shows a young person from the waist up, sitting with their hands folded on a brown surface. The person is angled slightly to the left, looking up into the distance. They have pale skin, soft, rounded facial features, and long, wavy light brown hair. They wear a vibrant red garment with green ties down the front and a red cap on their head. In the background, there are rocky blue and brown cliffs, tall leafy green trees, and tall gray buildings and towers under a clear blue sky.

nga-52949.text: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is seated, resting his right arm on the arm of a chair. The man has fair skin, dark curly hair, and a composed expression. He is dressed in formal attire, including a white shirt, vest with red, white, and green or blue stripes, and a dark jacket. The background is a blend of browns.

nga-46531.text: A pale-skinned young woman with copper-orange hair, wearing a turquoise-blue robe, stands in a pastel-infused landscape in this stylized, vertical painting. The woman fills most of the left half of the composition. She faces our right in profile with her head bowed as she looks down at the silver and brown box she holds in her right hand, closer to us. Her body angles away from us so we see her back. Her hair is held back under a gold-colored headand, and her blue robe falls over a white skirt.

nga-128004.text: This painting shows the upper body of a person seated at an easel. The individual is looking towards us, with their body facing the easel on the right. They have medium-length brown hair, a round, pale face, and dark eyes. The person is wearing a brown garment over a white shirt, holding a wooden palette in one hand with paint and paintbrushes. Their other hand is lifting a brush to the easel. In the dark gray background, there are indistinct objects on a shelf and a sketch pinned on the wall depicting another person in a profile view, turned to the left.

nga-34144.text: The image shows a woman seated in a red armchair. She is depicted from the waist up with her hands folded in her lap, holding a white lace handkerchief. She has a neutral expression, dark eyes, and wears a dark gown with intricate detailing, a white lace collar, and a lace bonnet with a ribbon. The background is plain and dark.

nga-43678.text: Two pale-skinned girls stand hand in hand in a grassy field in this vertical painting. To our left, the younger girl is about two heads shorter than her companion and holds a doll clutched in the crook of her right arm. She has short, light blond hair, and she stares at us or just above our heads with wide, blue eyes. She has round cheeks, and her rosebud-shaped mouth is parted. She wears a moss-green skirt patterned with lilac-purple flowers, a tan sash around her waist, and a shirt with violet-purple and navy-blue, vertical stripes on the torso and elbow-length white sleeves.

nga-21.text: This vertical portrait shows the head, shoulders, and chest of a young man with smooth, pale skin and shoulder-length, dark blond hair positioned behind a narrow gray, stone ledge. Shown against a black background, the man tilts his head to our left and his eyes cut to our right. His left eyebrow, on our right, is slightly arched over brown eyes. He has a long, straight nose, pale pink lips, and his hair falls down the sides of his face from beneath a crimson-red, flat-topped cap. He wears a brown garment with white linen peeking through at the shoulder seams.

nga-42456.text: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, seated and holding a piece of lacework. She faces slightly to her right, with a direct gaze. Her facial features include deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and slightly pursed lips. She wears a white cap with lace edges and an olive-green dress with long sleeves. A white shawl drapes over her dress and is tied into a bow at the front. She wears a string of pearls around her neck. Beside her is a table with a decorative cloth featuring floral motifs. The background is a plain, muted tone.

nga-130842.text: This painting is an abstract composition of irregular shapes and vibrant colors. The different sections overlap and intersect in shades of green, blue, red, purple, and pink. A blue section in the top left has black dots, and two purple sections towards the bottom have white dots with yellow centers. In the upper center of the painting, there is a section of crossing black lines in a small grid. The paint has been applied unevenly in thick, scribbled lines, and some patches of the white canvas are visible.

nga-34070.text: The image shows a man seated in a large blue chair. He is dressed in a golden-brown silk robe, holding a closed book in his lap. The man has a neutral expression and his gaze is directed towards the viewer. He has a broad forehead, light eyebrows, and gray curly hair that falls to his shoulders. The background includes architectural elements like a column on the right side.

nga-41640.text: A woman struggles against a man who grips her shoulder to push her back onto a canopied bed in this vertical painting. Both people have pale skin. Bright light coming from our left illuminates the pair and the bed, while the area beyond is in deep shadow, creating a black background. To our left, the man faces the woman so we see him in profile facing our right, though much of his face is in shadow. He wears a silver breastplate over a white and gold tunic, which has a lion’s face on the sleeve facing us.

nga-47179.text: We look slightly down across a sun-drenched plaza with people scattered among ruins, buildings, and around a free-standing column in this vertical landscape painting. The people we can see have light skin. Towering trees with celery, sage, and forest-green leaves frame a small plaza paved with flax-colored stones. A tree to our right almost reaches the top of the painting, and a shorter tree in front of it has toppled onto the plaza. To our left, in the lower corner, a man sits behind a shadowy balustrade, looking down.

nga-106.text: This painting is a portrait of a woman, her torso facing slightly to the left, her face looking directly at us. The woman has fair skin, rosy cheeks, and red lips in a subtle smile. Her hair is dark brown, voluminous, and curled, extending past her shoulders. The woman is dressed in a white gown with ruffled lace and white buttons. She wears a wide-brimmed hat with a blue-grey underside that matches a blue sash around her waist. Her hand rests on her midsection, holding a part of the sash. The background depicts abstract foliage in muted greens and yellows under a gray sky.

nga-30344.text: The man in the image is seated and wearing a dark brown coat with brass buttons over a white shirt and ruffled cravat. He has light brown curly hair and is holding a book with a golden cover in his left hand. The background is plain green and the chair he is sitting on is upholstered in red fabric.

nga-12151.text: This is a fresco showing a pastoral scene with human activity. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, overlooking a hilly landscape with structures, trees, and five people, some of whom are dressed in gold robes. The people are engaged in various activities such as walking across the hills or kneeling beside a tree, tending to something on the ground. The person closest to us is to the left of center, kneeling down and lifting a small hammer in the air. This person has pale skin and golden hair, and they wear a golden robe over a white shirt and white pants.

nga-3199.text: Shown from the chest up, a pale-skinned man wearing a ruffled collar and ornately decorated doublet looks at us from the corners of his eyes in this vertical portrait painting. His shoulders and face angle to our left, but he gazes steadily our way with bright blue eyes under low, thin brows. He has a straight nose with a rounded tip, and his coral-pink lips are closed under a faint suggestion of a mustache and perhaps a beard. His short brown hair is brushed back from his high forehead, and his white collar curls in figure eights high along his chin and up the back of his neck.

nga-60791.text: The image shows the upper half of a seated woman, angled slightly to the side but facing forward. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark brown curly hair, and wears a white lace cap with a lace collar over a dark garment. A red fabric is draped around her shoulders. The background is plain with an indistinct vertical line to the side.

nga-14.text: A young, pale-skinned woman with long, blond hair and wearing a coral-red gown stands on a pedestal before a landscape filled with people in this vertical painting. The painting has an arched top, and the woman who fills most of the view is Claudia Quinta. Her hair is adorned with strands of pearls, and a larger pearl hangs from a piece of jewelry like a brooch at the top center over her forehead. A sheer veil covers the back of her head. Her body faces us but she turns her head slightly to our right, so she gazes at us from the corners of her light hazel eyes.

nga-59900.text: The image shows a woman portrait from the waist up. She is seated upright, holding a book in her left hand. She has blue eyes, dark brown hair styled with rolls and a braided crown, and wears elegant 19th-century clothing with a lace collar, a blue-gray garment, and gold earrings. The background is plain, and she is seated on a wooden chair.

nga-46663.text: The image shows a woman seated in a chair. She has dark brown hair in a neat updo, soft facial features, and light skin. She wears a black gown with a white lace collar, a gold necklace with a red pendant, a bracelet, and rings. She holds a red closed fan in her right hand. The background is a light-colored wall, and she sits on a chair with golden upholstery. A small round box is placed on the chair's armrest to her right.

nga-41614.text: About fifty pale-skinned men, women, and children along with a giraffe, ox, and other animals gather in groups across a hilly landscape in this vertical painting. The people wear robes or dresses in shades of carnation pink, honey orange, sky blue, ruby red, leaf green, or golden brown. The people’s skin is painted pearl white or, in a few instances, tinged with gray. A crowd of eight men and women gather in the lower left quadrant behind a man who points to the right with a stick. Others sit on the ground or on rocks, stand at barrel-sized urns, or bend to the ground.

nga-1184.text: Shown from the knees up, a light-skinned man wearing a loose, ink-black garment with a white collar leans back in a wooden chair in this vertical portrait painting. His body faces our left almost in profile, but he turns his head to look at us from the corners of his light hazel-brown eyes, the eyebrow closer to us slightly cocked. Crow’s feet line the corners of his hooded eyes. He is lit from our right so the side of his face to our left is in shadow. His slightly hollow cheeks are lined between his nose and mouth with wrinkles.

nga-43451.text: The image depicts a woman seated in a red chair. She is facing the viewer, with distinct facial features, fair complexion, dark hair styled in curls, and wearing a white bonnet with a green and orange ribbon. She has a dark, patterned dress with long sleeves, a white lace collar, pearls around her neck, and a circular brooch at the center of her collar. The background is a gradient from dark to light hues.

nga-121096.text: This painting presents a series of curved and bending lines intersecting with each other in an abstract pattern. The lines create a design resembling tree branches and leafy canopies. The background displays a mix of blue, yellow, and pink colors. At the base of the trees there are two red shapes that could be compared to small animals or creatures amidst the abstract landscape; one of them perches in a tree, while the other is on the ground, looking up.

cma-94979.text: Hurd was a prominent silversmith and engraver in Boston, and the warm gaze and unforced smile in his portrait by Copley suggest the friendship between the two artists. Hurd's open-collared shirt, as well as the rakishly tilted turban that covers his shaved head in place of a ceremonial powdered wig, create an air of informality that is unusual for a portrait of this time.

nga-52266.text: The image depicts a woman seated outdoors. She is looking directly at the viewer with a serene expression. She has soft facial features, full lips, and expressive eyes. Her hair is voluminous and curls around her face and shoulders. She wears a light-colored gown with sheer sleeves and a fitted waist. The background shows trees and foliage, with a distant horizon visible. The scene conveys a peaceful moment in nature.

nga-41599.text: A man and two women walk on a dirt path through a verdant landscape, carrying packs, walking sticks, and other provisions, while in the distance fiery explosions spew flames and plumes of smoke sky-high in this horizontal painting. The people all have pale skin, and the women’s blond hair is bound up. Close to us and at the bottom center of the composition, the man and women walk to our right with their eyes cast down. The man walks at the front of the line, holding a stick with a canteen dangling from a cord over his right shoulder.

cma-137259.text: Gustave Courbet painted four portraits of Madame Laure Borreau; this is the last and most highly developed. As a realist, Courbet aimed to represent what he saw in the visible, tangible world. He represented Madame Borreau in a black silk dress embellished with lace and a matching hat. Gold and violet lights of sunset softly illuminate the background. However, the portrait is not idealized. Courbet’s inclusion of her shadowed eyes and full-fleshed neck prompted one critic to write, “I daresay in nature she may be very pretty, but in Courbet’s picture she is nothing less than offensive.”

nga-37630.text: The image shows a seated woman in a side profile. She has soft facial features, brown hair neatly arranged under a lace bonnet, and is dressed in formal attire with a high lace collar. She wears a large oval brooch on her chest and a ring on her left hand. The background is a solid warm brown color.

nga-42408.text: The image shows a young boy standing on a dirt path, holding strings attached to a wooden toy with wheels. He is raising his left hand with a stick. The boy has short, neat light brown hair, fair skin, rosy cheeks, and bright eyes. He wears a red and green checkered shirt, gray trousers, and black shoes. In the background, there are white houses with red chimneys, trees, a sky with clouds, and a picket fence.

cma-129300.text: King George III commissioned more than 80 paintings from West, including this portrait that celebrates his military leadership by presenting him in a suit of armor. Such an image likely was intended to bolster George III's reputation, which had been tarnished the previous year when he was forced to formally recognize American independence.

nga-52950.text: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the right, with his left arm draped over the back of a red chair and his right hand resting on his lap. He has a fair complexion, clean-shaven face, prominent cheekbones, and deep-set eyes. His short light brown hair is slightly tousled. The man is wearing a black coat, a black waistcoat, a white high-collared shirt, and a black cravat. The background is a muted dark brown color.

nga-57102.text: The painting shows a forested landscape from an elevated angle. The horizon is high in the composition, with a blue sky and fluffy white clouds in the background. A large, gnarled tree trunk is in the center, with more tall trees behind it, their leaves in shades of dark green and rusty red. In the bottom left corner, we can see a group of people gathered on the dark brown ground. They are in shadow, but we can see their clothes, which are in shades of red, brown, black, and white. Three of them wear wide-brimmed hats, while the fourth appears to be a woman with her hair pulled back in a bun.

cma-124092.text: Every detail of his subject’s elaborate costume is skillfully recorded: glittering jewels, filmy lace, knots of ribbons, heavy black silk, and shimmering white satin. The ability to recreate satin’s luster was Gerard ter Borch’s particular trademark: he used fine flicks and sweeps of the brush, occasionally adding and wiping away tiny bits of paint to make the white fabric appear to shine. Ter Borch offset the profusion of costume detail by deliberately isolating the figure within a spare setting, allowing us to appreciate the woman’s cool composure.

nga-1098.text: This painting shows a seated man from the waist up who looks directly at us. The man has light skin and a beard and mustache in a reddish-brown shade. His hair is similarly colored. He has a straight nose and round, dark eyes under curved eyebrows. He wears a dark suit with a white collar visible at the neck, covered by a charcoal gray overcoat. In his right hand, resting on his lap, he holds a cigar, and a gold ring is visible on his hand, with a chain across his torso. The background is dark brown and almost black in some areas.

nga-56739.text: This painting shows multiple birds on and around a small, leafy tree. The birds are a variety of colors and sizes, including birds that look like hawks, blue jays, hummingbirds, magpies, and kestrels. They are shades of black, white, brown, gray, red, yellow, and pale blue. The birds are positioned at various heights on the small tree and on the ground below, all facing different directions. The ground is green, with small grasses and ferns, and the sky behind the tree is pale yellow.

cma-302209.text: Assuming a relaxed but commanding pose, Colonel Charles Heathcote (1734–1797) stands beside a large oak tree in the foreground of an expansive landscape. He wears military dress, the single epaulette on his right shoulder designating his rank as colonel. Wright’s composition demonstrates his new-found fascination with landscape: while the figure is relatively smoothly painted, the landscape is painted far more energetically, using thickly applied daubs of color.

nga-42395.text: The image shows a man's upper body from the chest up. He is slightly turned to the side with his hands clasped together, holding a folded cloth. The man has a serious expression with prominent cheekbones, a furrowed brow, light facial hair, including a mustache, short brown hair mostly covered by a dark cap, and is dressed in a dark garment with a high, white ruffled collar. A ring is on his left ring finger. The background is muted green.

nga-53583.text: The image shows a young child seated on a rock in a garden setting. The child has fair skin, rosy cheeks, large blue eyes, and curly brown hair. They wear a dark blue dress with a lace collar, and dark shoes with bows over white socks. The child holds a small hammer in their left hand. The background features lush greenery, a stone path, a small, white gazebo, and a picket fence with flowers.
